title: Chapter 121
text:
Han Xiao looked up from behind the scope with a surprised expression. He was also shocked by the power of the three shots. The second shot had hit a vital point and dealt a critical hit. Coupled with the fact that Bai Jin's attributes were greatly weakened, the damage was almost doubled. The damage of the first two shots was off the charts. Han Xiao estimated that a Level 48 Esper like Bai Jin, who was strong in offense but weak in defense, would have around 2,500 HP. Hence, the third shot was judged to be a lethal attack, directly killing Bai Jin!

Most importantly, the first shot had dealt an explosive amount of damage, which had multiplied by several times. It had directly knocked White Ember to his knees, turning him into a sitting duck.

Backstab damage = Siege Crossbow. This was indeed common knowledge!

You have killed Bai Jin (LV 48). You have received 64000 EXP.

You have killed a target 14 levels above you. Bonus 360% EXP. Total EXP: 230400. Your damage output is 100%!

You have received 230400 (100%) EXP!

Han Xiao did not expect that he would be able to successfully kill a target that was above his level. He had received nearly 300,000 EXP in one go, making up for the loss of constantly fusing blueprints to create the Ghost sniper rifle. He still had some left over.

Looking outside the manor again, the whole place was eerily silent.

Everyone was stunned. They had thought that a huge battle would break out, and they were all prepared for a tough battle. However, things had happened too suddenly, and they were all stunned.

Ta ta ta … Footsteps sounded in the forest, and everyone's eyes immediately focused on the source of the footsteps with curiosity, awe, and shock.

At this time, dark clouds gradually covered the moon, and the silvery moonlight disappeared inch by inch. At this time, Han Xiao walked out of the forest in a black trench coat. Only the lower half of his face was illuminated. The moonlight seemed to shrink as he moved forward, and darkness spread with his footsteps. He was like a nightmare that came with the night, a ghost that was always hidden in the night.

This extremely handsome appearance immediately caused a series of gasps. The image of this moment was like a brand that was deeply engraved in the hearts of everyone. Everyone knew that they would never be able to forget this scene!

"Mr. Black!"

"It's actually him?"

Everyone was shocked. They knew that Mr. Hei was very strong, but they did not expect him to be this strong!

Bennett was very surprised. He didn't expect that he would make a mistake this time. With the destructive power that Han Xiao had just displayed, it was enough to pose a threat to him. When Han Xiao came closer, Bennett couldn't help but praise, "Well done."

"It's just so-so." Han Xiao never forgot to be modest.

Looking around, Han Xiao saw that the surrounding mercenaries were staring at him without moving. He said in a deep voice, "Don't just stand there, go do what you need to do."

The mercenaries seemed to have woken up from a dream and hurriedly began to repair the manor's fortifications. They all subconsciously allowed Han Xiao to give orders.

Bai Jin's corpse was moved in and casually covered with a cloth. No one would forget that this was the corpse of a powerful Super. Every time they saw it, their respect for Han Xiao deepened.

The enemy's corpse was a medal.

Han Xiao walked into the villa, and Wang Yuan came over. This time, his smile was no longer polite. It was full of admiration and sincerity. He said, "What an amazing three shots. Even this old man was shocked by you."

"You're too polite." Han Xiao waved his hand and glanced at Bennett beside him. "With him here, your life won't be in danger at all."

Wang Yuan smiled and said, "I've checked the files. The Rothschild Family recommended you for this mission. Your strength is far beyond the standard of a Scorpion Grade. I'll directly promote you to Ghost Grade."

This was an obvious gesture of goodwill. Han Xiao was pleasantly surprised to be promoted to Ghost Grade in one try. He nodded and accepted Wang Yuan's goodwill.

…

In the forest, Di Su Su reported Han Xiao's performance with a solemn expression.

"Mr. Black has terrifying sniping abilities, and his destructive power is unpredictable. I suggest adding him to the list of major threats."

"Permission granted." Mo Ran said in a deep voice.

Division 13 had a record of all extremely dangerous targets, which was the so-called 'major threat' file. Han Xiao's performance had already attracted their attention, especially since he was a sniper, a profession that specialized in assassination.

…

Early the next morning, Wang Yuan gathered all the mercenaries and stated that the guard mission was over, and that the payment for the mission would be directly credited to their accounts.

With all the traitors in the organization captured, Wang Yuan's goal was accomplished. As for the Hidden Demon, since his employer was dead, he naturally wouldn't continue to assassinate him.

Han Xiao checked his bank account. This time, he had received two million, which was twice as much as the original reward. After thinking about it, he understood that this was the extra reward that Wang Yuan gave him. His performance in the last three shots was worth this price.

[Round 5 completed. You have received 30000 EXP]

Hidden requirement "Bennett did not join the battle" completed. You received 300,000 EXP.

This time, there was no new chain quest, which meant that the chain quest was over. At this time, the experience points accumulated had directly broken through the 1,000,000 mark! The reward for this mission was very generous.

"I've finally completed this mission."

Han Xiao felt a lot more relaxed. He found Bennett and gave him the Lock HOC sniper rifle.

"You're giving me a gift again?" Bennett was very surprised. Seeing that the gift this time was to his liking, he said helplessly, "What do you want?"

"I want to learn combat techniques."

Why is it this sentence again?

Bennett's head hurt. After thinking for a while, he decided to teach Han Xiao the techniques that were suitable for his sniping ability.

"In my early years, I was an assassin who specialized in stealth in the dark. Perhaps these techniques of mine will be of some help to you …"

After listening to the explanation for an hour, Han Xiao received a new mission.

You have triggered Level D Mission [Night Stalker (Class Change)]

Mission Introduction: You have learned some special techniques from Bennett's explanation, but you still need to perfect them with practice.

Mission Requirements: Complete five assassination missions in a dark environment (Level is not limited).

Reward: Receive [Night Stalker] Class.

Night Stalker, this was the subclass that Han Xiao had wanted to get from Bennett for a long time. He would be able to learn skills such as Stealth, Stealth, and Critical Strike Bonus. Together with his Flaming Will and Ghost sniper rifle, he would be able to perfect the combat style of the Stealth Sniper Style. Furthermore, he would have a chance to activate the [Lethal Shot] talent.

Furthermore, this subclass was very rare in Version 1.0. The attribute bonus was not low, and the experience required to level up was less than the main class. Just leveling up the main class required a huge amount of experience, and the subclass was mainly used to increase his combat abilities.

After finishing the explanation, Bennett paused and said, "I can see that your Ki is not strong, but your killing power is incredible. This is my number. You can call me anytime. Of course, I may need you to do something for me in the future. What do you think?"

"Okay."

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He immediately thought of the other main mission related to Bennett. Naturally, he had no objections. They exchanged numbers.

He forgot to mention that Han Technician was no longer using the black brick phone that Division 13 had given him.

The guarding mission was finally over, and the mercenaries in the manor heaved a sigh of relief. They started to pack up and prepare to leave. Han Xiao walked around and received a bunch of phone numbers from the leaders of the assassins and mercenaries. He had gained a lot of connections, and these people might come in handy one day.

Golden Fox took the initiative to give her number to Han Xiao and ran away in a hurry. She was in awe of Han Xiao's strength, but she could not accept his taste in women. She had no intention of doing anything.

The manor became quiet, and everyone started to leave. Han Xiao drove back to Seagull City's airport and boarded Fabian's plane.

After completing two high-reward missions, Han Xiao had accumulated a huge amount of experience. The general plan for the last period before the public beta would be based on the missions that were mainly for rewards.

I have already become a Ghost Level Assassin. Missions, commissions, and intelligence have priority. Now that I have paved the way, as long as I do it step by step, I will definitely be able to obtain Legendary Points. Then, I will be free to complete the last goal …

F * ck Germinal!

I hope you guys can withstand my storm-like love.

Han Xiao smiled slyly, but at the same time, it was very cold.

…

In the intelligence department of Division 13, the head of the intelligence department received a file transfer report. It was an application for 'Mr. Black' to be transferred into the file of a major threat target.

"Mr. Black. Origin and birth unknown. Currently, he is an assassin of the Blood Pact Society. He has only completed two missions. He destroyed the Rose Militant mercenary group in the Somar Desert and displayed extraordinary sniping skills when he was guarding the River Valley Manor. He repelled the Invisible Demon and killed Embers of Lightning with three shots.

This person is extremely vigilant and has excellent stealth skills (Appendix – Once shook off the stalkers of Division 13). Furthermore, he is a mechanic. His boots have the ability to glide at high speeds. The sniper rifle he uses is a specially made weapon with amazing lethality. He requires special attention. "

"Another powerful guy has appeared. Sigh."

After reading the information sent by the Seagull City branch, the head of the intelligence department sighed. He took out his seal and stamped it on the footer of the document.

"Entry approved!"

…

Something big happened in the underground world. There was a shocking change in the Dark Net's assassin ranking list. An unknown assassin with the code name 'Mr. Black' had rocketed from the top 1,000 to the 23rd assassin ranking list.

"I have never heard of this name. What is his background?"

"The Dark Net's ranking list has always been fair. It is impossible to manipulate it. Go and find out about Mr. Black's background immediately."

In the strongholds of different forces, many people were calling each other to ask around. The underground world's intelligence network was interconnected, and the basic information was quickly obtained. Some of the mercenaries and assassins who had fought side by side in River Valley Manor leaked the information.

Han Xiao's achievement of killing Bai Jin in three shots had instantly attracted the attention of the underground world.

The first reaction of those who knew the name of Lightning Mauler was to think that the information was fake. However, they were faced with concrete evidence. A mercenary took a picture of Bai Jin's tragic death. It was a wound caused by three gunshots!

The experienced assassins were shocked. Although Bai Jin was strong in attack and weak in defense, he was still a high-level Blue Star. He was not afraid of bullets. How could he be killed in one shot?

More people went to investigate Mr. Black's background, but they found that this person seemed to have appeared out of thin air. No one knew his previous identity. He was like a ghost that suddenly appeared and floated in the underground world.

Mysterious and powerful, Mr. Black's code name began to become famous in the underground world and entered the list of many forces.

The old-school theory was that assassins should hide in the dark. Being famous was tantamount to failure. However, for the Blood Pact Society, being famous was the only way to get customers. Fame was also a deterrent. Anyone who dared to threaten the Dark Net would have to consider whether they could withstand the continuous assassination of the Assassin Alliance!

Since the veteran assassins of the Blood Pact Society died, left, or retired, the reputation of the Assassin Alliance was declining day by day. The Blood Pact Society was faintly trying to make Mr. Black their signature.
